_comment: Scan presets for universe_screen.py. Edit/add entries here (or pass --presets-file). Keys: regime_weights (base score per regime; 0 = excluded), min_volume_usd (liquidity floor), max_symbols (how many to scan after liquidity filter), interval (15m|1h|4h|1d), limit (candle window), exclude (substring, case-insensitive), atr_min/atr_max (range window for harvest regimes), step_atr_factor/step_min/step_max (grid step = clamp(ATR% * factor, min, max) in %; spread > step/2 is flagged, spread >= step is unharvestable).

grid-neutral.description: Neutral / mean-reversion grid candidates (chop + squeeze + neutral); trending names scored 0

grid-directional.description: Directional grid candidates (trend_up -> Long grid, trend_down -> Short grid)

trend-classic.description: Classic / DCA trend candidates for the MCP strategy surface (place_strategy_trade)

squeeze.description: Squeeze (breakout-pending) candidates — tight range grid with Stop Trigger, or breakout entry
